## The Tech Hiring Challenge

In the tech industry, great developers have their pick of opportunities. Your job posting competes with hundreds of others, and top candidates are off the market within 10 days.

You need specialized skills (cloud architecture, AI/ML, cybersecurity, blockchain) but can't always justify permanent headcount for emerging technologies that may evolve.

Traditional recruiting eats 3-6 months and 20-30% of first-year salary in fees. Meanwhile, your product roadmap slips and competitors ship faster.

### The TaaSFlow Solution

- Pre-screened developers with proven project experience and code samples reviewed
- Full-stack, backend, frontend, mobile, and DevOps specialists available
- Familiar with modern stacks: React, Node, Python, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes
- Remote-first talent experienced with async collaboration and agile workflows
- Scale from 1 developer to an entire team, up or down as projects evolve
